LandingPage.title: Track every arrow.
LandingPage.subtitle: Improve every session.
LandingPage.description: Quiver is a mobile-first archery training tracker. Record sessions, mark arrow placement on interactive targets, and review your progress over time.
LandingPage.heroMediaLabel: Recording arrows on an indoor 5-spot target
LandingPage.featuresTitle: Everything you need to train smarter
LandingPage.featureMultipleTargetsDesc: Indoor 1-spot, Indoor 5-spot, Flint 1-spot, and Flint 4-spot targets.
LandingPage.featureTouchDesc: Tap and drag on the target, with a zoom overlay for precise positioning.
LandingPage.featureSummaryDesc: Review shot charts, group radius, aim offset, and per-arrow score tables.
LandingPage.featureEditingDesc: Tap any arrow score to correct it inline without re-recording.
LandingPage.featureNotesDesc: Add notes and a star rating to remember how each session felt.
LandingPage.featureDarkModeDesc: Comfortable viewing in any lighting with a built-in theme toggle.
LandingPage.galleryDescription: From recording arrows on different target faces to reviewing detailed analytics after each session.
LandingPage.screenshotAnalytics3: Analytics — points per end & score distribution
LandingPage.ctaTitle: Ready to level up your archery training?
LandingPage.ctaDescription: Sign up for free and start recording your first session in seconds.
LandingPage.footer: Built with Next.js, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS.
